adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts`, `createEvent` now returns `externalId` purely from its new optional parameter (it does not derive it from `calEvent.destinationCalendar`). In `packages/core/EventManager.ts#createAllCalendarEvents`, the fallback branch for destinations without `credentialId` calls `createEvent(c, event)` without passing `destination.externalId`, so the resulting `EventResult.externalId` is `undefined`. Later, when building booking references, `externalCalendarId` is now taken from `result.externalId` (replacing the previous `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId` usage), meaning these bookings will store an undefined/null `externalCalendarId`. The GoogleCalendarService update/delete logic now falls back to `"primary"` when `externalCalendarId` is falsy, which can 404 if the event was created in a non-primary calendar—so reschedules/cancellations can fail for that fallback path.
